# The GrowHub Sponsors Giveaway at Bedok Mid-Autumn Celebration


Nov 28


Written By[Guest User](https://thegrowhub.co/news?author=696085f024d98b24c865f480)


As part of our CSR efforts this year,[The GrowHub Innovations Company](https://www.linkedin.com/company/thegrowhub/) sponsored a giveaway of more that 1,500 packs of regenerative oat milk for the Bedok Mid-Autumn Celebration through our good partners at[People's Association](https://www.linkedin.com/company/peoplesassociation/) . We were fortunate to have a photo taken with our Deputy Prime Minister, Mr. Heng Swee Keat in the course of the giveaway.
